title: Chapter 296: Both Become Emperors
content:
Chapter 296: Both Become Emperors

"Damn, Xiao Luo, what's wrong with you?!"

Lu Xue looked from a distance and immediately saw Xiao Luo sitting cross-legged in the distance, his breath was very disordered.

Could it be that something went wrong with Emperor Cheng?

Sure enough, there was indeed something wrong with the Emperor's Tribulation.

Lu Xue looked ugly and rushed over quickly.

On the shoulder, Ao Qing frowned slightly, "No, why is Qin Feng okay?"

Hearing this, Lu Xue was slightly stunned, "Huh? Qin Feng is okay?"

Ao Qing nodded, "Yes, that guy probably has become an emperor at this moment."

"That's weird."

"Let's go and have a look first."

When he came to Xiao Luo, he saw Xiao Luo closing his eyes tightly and trembling all over his body.

It can be seen from the naked eye that Xiao Luo's face was very bad.

"Xiao Luo, who can do this?!"

"Tell me, I'll avenge you!"

When Lu Xue saw Xiao Luo's appearance in front of her, she was immediately furious.

There must be some villain who is not doing tricks when he is not doing anything.

Damn it.

Don't be caught by her.

But on Lu Xue's shoulder, Ao Qing saw the eyebrows.

I saw a faint frost hanging on Xiao Luo's trembling eyelashes.

Could it be?

"My little master, this kid seems to be frozen."

Frozen?

The air suddenly solidified.

The whole scene was very awkward.

Lu Xue's expression changed several times in one second, which was extremely exciting.

Only then did she remember that she seemed to have exploded too hard and forgot Xiao Luo who was still behind her.

The ice aura in the ice domain, let alone Xiao Luo, who broke through to become an emperor at a critical moment, even the woman in the Immortal Emperor realm can be affected.

Xiao Luo is also really strong.

I haven't said a word until now.

"Ah haha, it turns out to be a misunderstanding, misunderstanding."

"Xiaoqing, why are you still standing there? Hurry up and light the fire, don't let Xiao Luo freeze to death."

Hearing this, Ao Qing didn't procrastinate and opened her mouth and squirted.

Huh ~

A mouthful of dragon breath was sprayed out directly.

However, by chance, it all happened to be sprayed on Xiao Luo's delicate and handsome face.

......

The air solidifies again.

"Xiaoqing, what are you doing?!"

Lu Xue jumped up immediately.

Ao Qing felt a little wronged.

"My little master, didn't you ask me to ignite the fire? I just didn't control the fire level."

What he is best at is the ice system.

Hearing this, Lu Xue punched Ao Qing in the head and said with a grudge: "I asked you to build a fire on the side, not to let you ignite the fire at Xiao Luo."

On the side, Xiao Luo, who had experienced the two heavens of ice and fire, suddenly had a sudden breath.

Break through in desperate situations!

Buzz —

The aura of the Immortal Lord Realm gradually sublimated, and the aura of the Immortal Emperor Realm slowly sublimated.

The Xiao clan has another powerful man from the Immortal Emperor realm!

"Hahaha, Brother Xiao, you are too slow."

At this moment, a hearty laughter came from afar.

Lu Xue looked up and saw a man in a robe stepping on the fairy sword and coming with his sword.

His long hair drifted in the wind, and his sword intent was constantly rising all over his body, looking mysterious and unpredictable.

If you are not Qin Feng, who else can you have such a handsome appearance?

At the same time, Xiao Luo, who was sitting cross-legged on the ground, also slowly stood up.

His breath began to gradually restrain himself.

"Sister Xue, fulfilled her mission and successfully survived the imperial tribulation."

Xiao Luo turned around and bent towards Lu Xue.

But the last few words are very pronounced.

Upon hearing this, Lu Xue's face turned slightly red and she smiled and said, "It's good to succeed, it's good to succeed."

Qin Feng fell to the ground and scratched his head at a loss.

His intuition told him that something must have happened here just now.

Then Qin Feng asked directly: "May I ask, what happened just now?"

"Shut up!"

As soon as he said that, Lu Xue's angrily scolded him.

Seeing this, Qin Feng quickly shut up.

No one can mess with this young lady.

"My master, can we go inside now?"

At this moment, Ao Qing suddenly spoke.

Hearing this, Xiao Luo and Qin Feng were slightly stunned, but then they felt relieved.

It was a bit reluctant to enter before.

But now both of them have broken through to the Immortal Emperor realm and their strength is completely enough.

As for Lu Xue and Ao Qing, these two cannot be described as common sense.

Everyone is as strong as a monster.

Especially Lu Xue.

Although Xiao Luo did not see the battle just now, he did feel it deeply.

Even now that he is in the Immortal Emperor Realm, he is not sure that he can defeat Lu Xue in the Immortal Lord Realm.

You know, this is a big realm.

And it is the most difficult imperial realm to cross.

The Emperor Realm is not as simple as saying.

Even the most trashy Emperor Realm can beat a large number of peaks in the Immortal Saint Realm.

As for the existence who can surpass the level of the Immortal Emperor Realm, it is almost the monster among the monsters. Looking at the history of the Immortal World, it is also a rare existence.

However, just now, Lu Xue did it.

And it is not the Immortal Saint Realm, but the Immortal Lord Realm.

If such a record is spread, it may scare a large number of geniuses from the outside world to death.

But what they didn't know was that the matter here was already spreading.

"Can."

After pondering for a moment, Lu Xue agreed.

She originally wanted to be more low-key, but now she realized that with her strength and talent, she could not be low-key at all.

Alas, I wanted to get along with you as an ordinary person.

Then don't pretend now.

Unexpectedly, one day I will be able to show off like my father.

"Dad, take a look. Your daughter, my name will soon resound throughout the entire fairy world."

Lu Xue murmured to herself, then led Ao Qing and Xiao Luo and Qin Feng toward the deepest part of the ancient battlefield.

Soon after, Lu Xue's name will really resound throughout the entire fairy world, but it will also attract a lot of other things.

After Lu Xue and his group left.

A voice suddenly appeared here sneakily.

"Are you leaving?"

I saw a young man looking at Lu Xue and others leaving, then wiped the cold sweat from his forehead.

That's right, this is the boy who brought the imperial disaster that Lu Xue and others saw at the beginning.

"I originally wanted to take advantage of my great strength to become an emperor and come here to find a bargain."

"What a fucking joke about the Immortal Lord Realm killing the Immortal Emperor Realm, it's so scary."

Thinking of Lu Xue’s battle with the woman with bow and arrow, the boy was very palpitations.

That is the real battle in the Immortal Emperor realm.

Look at yourself again, I'm afraid you will turn into cannon fodder when you go up.

Fortunately, I am safe and sound and have reached the Immortal Emperor realm.

Then I will definitely make a profit and never lose money this time.

The only regret is that ancient shield, which is also one of the purposes for him to sneak back.

That ancient shield once said that after he survived the imperial tribulation, he would have what kind of inheritance would he have.

Although he wanted to scold his mother at that time, it was different after he had passed by it.

"Oh, it seems that there is no chance."

After searching for a while, he couldn't find it, and he knew that he should have been taken away by Lu Xue and his group.

As for being destroyed by Lu Xue and his group, he didn't think about that at all.

However, just as he left, a faint call suddenly sounded from the ruins in the distance.

"Come here, kid."
